svg.title: REDESIGN — primary wordmark, geometrically centered
svg.desc: The REDESIGN brand wordmark with the full composition geometrically centered on the canvas. Because RE is shorter than DESIGN, the brass interpunct sits left of canvas center — but the wordmark as a whole is balanced on the page.
